verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs explicitly describe off-cycle payroll support for bonuses, corrections, and terminations outside the regular schedule (gusto-docs-4, gusto-docs-21, gusto-docs-32), with a dedicated 'create-an-off-cycle-payroll' guide detailing reason-based configuration like bonus withholding rules (gusto-docs-47) and platform overview confirming 'process regular and off-cycle payrolls' as a core capability (gusto-docs-44). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of off-cycle runs in production and explicit termination-specific documentation beyond generic 'off-cycle reason' mention.
